name: 2026 NCS SC Age Group Championships
location: Triangle Aquatic Center, 275 Convention Drive, Cary, NC 27511

sessions.name: Thursday Timed Finals
sessions.notes: Single-pool session. 13-14 1000Y Freestyle and 11-12 400Y IM are positive-check-in events (check-in 4:45 PM). 11-12 400Y IM swims in two heat groups within this session: fastest 24 (Heats 1-3) swim first, remaining heats (Heats 4+) swim after the 13-14 800Y Freestyle Relay. 13-14 100Y IM is a timed final (swum as 100Y despite qualifying via 200Y IM time).

sessions.name: Friday Preliminaries
sessions.notes: 13-14 400Y IM check-in deadline 8:45 AM Friday; fastest 2 heats circle-seeded.

sessions.name: Friday Afternoon Timed Finals
sessions.notes: Genuine two-pool split (venue's 50m bulkhead pool configured into two 8-lane 25Y courses run simultaneously). Pool 1 = 11-12; Pool 2 = 10 & Under. 11-12 400Y Freestyle Relay check-in 12:30 PM or 30 min before session start.

sessions.name: Friday Finals
sessions.notes: 13-14 400Y Freestyle Relay swims only in Finals (check-in end of prelims; relay cards due 5:30 PM).

sessions.name: Saturday Preliminaries
sessions.notes: 13-14 200Y Freestyle Relay swims only in prelims (no Finals occurrence). 13-14 500Y Freestyle check-in 8:45 AM. 13-14 400Y Medley Relay: remaining heats (beyond the fastest 2 / top 16) swim here at the end of prelims; fastest 2 heats swim in Saturday Finals.

sessions.name: Saturday Afternoon Timed Finals
sessions.notes: Two-pool split, Pool 1 = 11-12, Pool 2 = 10 & Under. 11-12 500Y Freestyle and 10&U 500Y Freestyle check-in 12:30 PM or 30 min before session start.

sessions.name: Saturday Finals
sessions.notes: 13-14 400Y Medley Relay: fastest 2 heats (top 16 teams) swim here at the end of Finals; check-in 8:45 AM, relay cards due 8:45 AM/5:30 PM.

sessions.name: Sunday Preliminaries
sessions.notes: 13-14 200Y Medley Relay swims only in prelims. 13-14 1650Y Freestyle check-in 6:00 PM Saturday; all heats except the fastest 8 girls/8 boys swim here at the end of prelims. Event order in this session follows the literal Order of Events (not numeric order) per the meet announcement; Sunday Finals follow numeric event order instead.

sessions.name: Sunday Afternoon Timed Finals
sessions.notes: Two-pool split, Pool 1 = 11-12, Pool 2 = 10 & Under. 11-12 400Y Medley Relay check-in 12:30 PM or 30 min before session start.

sessions.name: Sunday Finals
sessions.notes: Fastest 8 girls and 8 boys of the 13-14 1650Y Freestyle swim here first (no AM/PM option), followed by remaining Finals events in numeric event order.
